text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down without a clear pattern, reinforcing that recent price changes do not reliably predict what comes next.","Holding without trading has kept me from reacting to ordinary fluctuations; I should make future trades only for a clear reason, not out of impulse.","Losses bother me more than comparable gains please me, so I should follow a deliberate plan rather than let loss aversion dictate when I buy or sell."]}
